mapping.draft_py:
# Ruby, Daring Tracker (FDN), a legendary 1/2 Human Scout for {R}{G}.
# "Haste"                                 compiled keyword, kept
# "Whenever Ruby attacks while you control a creature with power 4 or greater, Ruby gets +2/+2
#  until end of turn."
# "{T}: Add {R} or {G}."                  compiled (B3-add-mana-choose), kept
# The attack trigger is FDN Courageous Goblin's mapped "Whenever this creature attacks while you
#   control a creature with power 4 or greater, ..." (M4 batch): the "while" clause is part of the
#   trigger event (MAPPER_GUIDE: only an intervening "if" is the condition), so the
#   CONTROLLER_COUNT_GE test of M21 Ornery Dilophosaur's verified "if you control a creature with
#   power 4 or greater" sits in the DeclareAttackersEvent filter beside IS_SOURCE. "A creature"
#   includes Ruby herself. The effect is Ornery Dilophosaur's verified "+2/+2 until end of turn"
#   on the source.
attack = TriggeredAbility(
    event=DeclareAttackersEvent(
        filter=FAnd(
            children=(
                FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_SOURCE),
                FAtom(
                    pred=FAtomPred.CONTROLLER_COUNT_GE,
                    count=QConst(value=1),
                    inner_filter=FAnd(
                        children=(
                            FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Creature'),
                            FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.POWER_GE, count=QConst(value=4)),
                        ),
                    ),
                ),
            ),
        ),
    ),
    condition=None,
    effect=A(Verb.MODIFY_PT, {
        'duration': DurationEot(),
        'power': PtDelta(direction=PtDirection.INCREASE, magnitude=QConst(value=2)),
        'target': Selector(
            count=QConst(value=1),
            mode=SelectorMode.CHOOSE,
            filter=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_SOURCE),
            zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),),
        ),
        'toughness': PtDelta(direction=PtDirection.INCREASE, magnitude=QConst(value=2)),
    }),
)
abilities = [attack, *compiled]

clauses.clause: Whenever Ruby attacks while you control a creature with power 4 or greater, Ruby gets +2/+2 until end of turn.
clauses.ir: abilities[0] (the 'while' test in the DeclareAttackersEvent filter)

mapping.notes: FDN Courageous Goblin's (M4) 'attacks while you control' test in the DeclareAttackersEvent filter, M21 Ornery Dilophosaur's power-4 count and +2/+2 until end of turn; the compiled haste and mana ability kept. Packs: tools/scenarios/mapped/FDN/ruby_no_bonus_without_your_power_four_creature.json, tools/scenarios/mapped/FDN/ruby_bonus_ends_with_the_turn.json.
